overview: The Strategic & Capital Planning Subcommittee met to review and prioritize the school district's capital plan spreadsheet in preparation for the upcoming budget process. The committee discussed project prioritizations, potential Community Preservation Act funding, and scheduled future meetings to finalize their presentation.

items.title: Capital Planning Overview and MSBA Project Approvals
items.summary: The subcommittee outlined the upcoming capital planning timeline and announced that the Massachusetts School Building Authority approved three statements of interest for roof and HVAC projects at the Roberts, Missituk, and Brooks schools.

items.title: Presentation of Prioritized Capital Plan Spreadsheet
items.summary: Kenneth Lord presented a prioritized capital plan incorporating data from the recent Facilities Condition Assessment and school principals, covering immediate and long-term needs such as fire alarms, network upgrades, and door and window replacements.

items.title: Playground Feasibility and Community Preservation Act Funding
items.summary: The committee and city representatives explored using Community Preservation Act funds to support feasibility and design studies for renovations at three remaining school playgrounds.

items.title: Subcommittee Next Steps and Scheduling
items.summary: The committee decided to dedicate their December 8 meeting to further refining the capital plan prioritization before presenting it to the full School Committee on December 15.

subject: School District Capital Plan Prioritization
